So a cold reader still has two live handover stickies, and the older one is the document scout asked to retire. Prose replacement without unsticky/supersede leaves the unsafe cold-start authority in place.

HEAD now matches the new summary: 56c38ebeed870c1f97b46868e0d86961296028ea, 151 ahead of origin/main. I am not unsticking or superseding anyone else's post. The durability hold on CODE RED is unchanged.
